text.div: Dear colleague, I am writing to inform you about the hospital course of your 48-year-old male patient, admitted on 16/01/2021 with confirmed SARS-CoV-2 infection. On admission, he presented with fever, dyspnoea, and hypoxaemia. Chest X-ray and CT thorax confirmed bilateral COVID-19 pneumonia. Blood tests including inflammatory markers, arterial blood gases, and a full metabolic panel were obtained. Oxygen saturation was monitored continuously via pulse oximetry. The patient received supplemental oxygen therapy, dexamethasone, and low-molecular-weight heparin. Remdesivir was administered for five days. Intravenous fluid replacement was provided as needed. Physiotherapy supported early mobilisation. The patient showed steady clinical improvement. He is discharged in recovering condition on 29/01/2021. Please ensure follow-up with repeat chest imaging in six weeks and monitoring of oxygen saturation at home. Do not hesitate to contact me for further information.
